## Symptoms
POST /orders returns 502. The quote request succeeded, but the log says the broker connection was lost during publish.

## Likely causes
1. The order service lost its connection to the broker.
2. The broker is restarting or unreachable.

## How to confirm
Check broker health and connection counts. Confirm the error text mentions the broker connection, not the pricing call.

## Fix options
Restart the order service so it reconnects. Check broker logs before restarting the broker.

## Escalate when
The broker is down or connections do not recover after a restart.
